asr.full_text: Welcome to MIRRA Trading International official investor presentation. The information shared in this presentation is not to be considered as financial advice. As members of MTI we are not financial advisers, we are merely sharing our personal experience of this opportunity. There is no guarantee that you will experience any or the same results. Please make sure you understand the opportunity and ask for clarification if you are unsure of any of the points shared in this presentation. Mira Trading International is a company registered in the Republic of South Africa The head office is situated at unit 1 on the ground floor 43 Plain Street Stillenboschch in the western Cape of South Africa. Johan Steenberg from Poliklone in South Africa is the CEO and Founder. The objective of Meritrading International is to grow your Bitcoin. Your balance in trade is always in Bitcoin, and you earn Bitcoin daily, provided we have a profitable trading day. This means the number of BTC in your trading pool will increase day by day. Bitcoin price fluctuations can affect the US dollar value of your trading pool. MiRTel has a sustainable business model Trading Forex using managed AI software with bitcoin as the base currency The profitability of Mirror trading international comes solely from the trading activities your full Bitcoin investment goes into your MTI trading account and no part thereof is used for referral or binary bonuses. MTI provides you with a passive income opportunity. No trading knowledge is required to earn passively from daily trading activities. Trading results are not guaranteed. In MTI there are no administration fees, no membership fees, no monthly subscription fees, no packages and no deposit or withdrawal fees. Profits from successful daily trades are divided and allocated as follows. 40% to you the member 20% to the weekly residual binary bonus pool 5% to the leadership bonus pool 25% to the traders 10% to MTI for administration Please remember that historical results are no guarantee of future results. All profit sharing is subject to positive daily trading results. The system is fully automated, and you'll receive your daily statement detailing the profit or loss from the trades for the day. These statements will be in your back office from Tuesdays to Saturdays. Your daily trade profits are automatically compounded in the trading pool. Compound profit is the eighth wonder of the world. In MTI, there are no contract and no lockdown periods. You can withdraw in full or partial amounts. You can withdraw at any time from Sunday at noon, which means time at noon to Friday 10pm . Your full requested Bitcoin amount will be sent to your bitcoin wallet within 48 hours. Providing you with a passive sustainable income from your Bitcoin in trade is at the very heart of Mirror trading international to start you will need to be at least 18 years of age register with MTI using the link provided to you by your sponsor and fund your account with bitcoin the required minimum is a hundred US dollars worth of bitcoin accounts not funded within seven days will be deleted however you may register again this summarizes the passive part of the Forex trading opportunity and as a Mirotrading International member you earn from the trading activities and grow your Bitcoin MTI has an Optional Referral program this is an added business opportunity should you wish to refer your friends or family. For more information, please contact the person who sent you this presentation.

It also provides withdrawal timing and account-funding instructions as part of the participation flow. Disclaimers state that the material is not financial advice and that historical or daily results are not guaranteed, but the video still promotes a Bitcoin-funded trading opportunity.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The presentation promotes funding a Bitcoin trading account and receiving passive income from daily trading activities, with profits allocated to members and automatically compounded. This directly supports an investment or managed-trading returns mechanism. The evidence does not establish paid mining or node returns, a qualifying credential or sensitive-data request, or a multi-person recruitment hierarchy.
